subject: palm
name: 棕榈树
label: 弯弯的椰子树
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One gently curved palm trunk with four broad fronds, two coconuts and no bark texture.
Pure black ink CONTOURS ONLY, smooth completely blank interiors. Absolutely no hatching, shaded volumes, gray shading or tonal fill. All tips fully visible with 10% clear margins.
